name: 6356-batchdecode-llama4mavfp8-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8 -- an ungated mirror of the identical `meta-llama` checkpoint; the Llama 4 Community License applies. 416.8 GB of safetensors, downloaded once on first start.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism; eight-way is forced, since 417 GB of weights does not fit on fewer than eight 80 GB cards.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration: a 400B-total / 17B-active MoE, 48 layers, 128 experts, compressed-tensors FP8 weights with a bf16 KV cache. A vision-language checkpoint, served TEXT-ONLY here.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 2700 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: exactly 1000 prompt tokens and exactly 1000 output tokens per request, no spread, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form text assistant on a 400-billion-parameter expert model, serving 64 concurrent thousand-token requests across eight GPUs.
launch:
# `unsloth/...` is an ungated mirror of the `meta-llama` checkpoint; the Llama 4 Community License applies.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8
tp-size: 8
context-length: 524288
chat-template: llama-4
